description: This is a PHP source file defining the AddressFormat class in the Opencart.Admin.Model.Localisation namespace. The class provides methods to manage address format records in a database, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving address format data.

classes.name: AddressFormat
classes.description: Represents address format management in the OpenCart admin localization module, providing CRUD operations.

methods.name: addAddressFormat
methods.description: Inserts a new address format record into the database with data provided as an array.

methods.name: editAddressFormat
methods.description: Updates an existing address format identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteAddressFormat
methods.description: Deletes an address format record from the database by ID.

methods.name: getAddressFormat
methods.description: Retrieves a specific address format record by ID.

methods.name: getAddressFormats
methods.description: Retrieves a list of address formats with optional pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAddressFormats
methods.description: Returns the total number of address format records.
